dataFlow: opencode run → bootstrap() → Instance.provide() → InstanceBootstrap() → [lazy] Provider.state() → Provider.getModel() → Provider.getSDK() → BunProc.install() → fs.mkdir(Global.Path.cache) → FAILURE

rootCauseHypotheses.evidence: BunProc.install() requires write access to Global.Path.cache (/root/.cache/opencode). DevBob pod might have read-only filesystem or volume mount conflicts.

rootCauseHypotheses.hypothesis: Environment variable not accessible during provider initialization
rootCauseHypotheses.evidence: Provider.state() at line 351 checks process.env for apiKey. If ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is not in process.env at initialization time, provider won't load.
rootCauseHypotheses.validation: Add debug logging in provider.ts line 351 to print process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY value

rootCauseHypotheses.hypothesis: Config file overrides environment variable incorrectly
rootCauseHypotheses.evidence: Config loading has complex merge logic (global → custom → workspace → .opencode). Malformed config could break provider initialization.
rootCauseHypotheses.validation: Check .opencode/opencode.json content and validate JSON syntax. Verify provider.anthropic.options.apiKey value.

rootCauseHypotheses.hypothesis: Network access blocked for npm registry
rootCauseHypotheses.evidence: BunProc.install() runs 'bun add @ai-sdk/anthropic' which requires network access to npm registry. DevBob pod might have network restrictions.
rootCauseHypotheses.validation: Run: docker exec devbob-pod curl -I https://registry.npmjs.org

rootCauseHypotheses.hypothesis: SDK module fails to load after installation
rootCauseHypotheses.evidence: Even if BunProc.install() succeeds, dynamic import at line 518 might fail due to module resolution issues or missing dependencies.
